description: This file contains utility functions for SQL store operations in the focalboard server, including database connection setup, error handling, and schema retrieval.

classes.name: ErrInvalidDBType
classes.description: Error type representing an unsupported database type.

methods.name: CloseRows
methods.description: Closes the sql.Rows and logs an error if closing fails.

methods.name: IsErrNotFound
methods.description: Checks if an error is a 'not found' error.

methods.name: MarshalJSONB
methods.description: Marshals data into JSON, optionally prefixing with a binary indicator.

methods.name: PrepareNewTestDatabase
methods.description: Prepares a new test database connection string based on environment variables and database type.

methods.name: deleteBoardRecord
methods.description: Deletes a board record without deleting child records; for unit testing.

methods.name: deleteBlockRecord
methods.description: Deletes a block record without deleting child records; for unit testing.

methods.name: castInt
methods.description: Returns a SQL cast expression for an integer value based on database type.

methods.name: GetSchemaName
methods.description: Retrieves the current schema name for the database.
